paths.eyebrow: For the person who follows the spark
paths.title: Gifts for curious adults
paths.description: Thoughtful gifts for adults who like following an idea into a book, a walk, a game, a language, or the night sky.
paths.lead: Some people do not need another possession. They need a good reason to follow the question they keep returning to.
paths.shopperCue: Listen for the subject they bring up without being asked: a place, a language, the stars, family history, or the way something works.

paths.eyebrow: For the thing they already love doing
paths.title: Gifts for hobby lovers
paths.description: Useful gifts for golfers, knitters, painters, and puzzle lovers—explained for shoppers who do not know the hobby as well as the recipient does.
paths.lead: You do not have to master their hobby. Notice the small interruption between them and the part they enjoy most.
paths.shopperCue: Look for the repeated annoyance: the lost place, the crowded table, the drying paint, or the little job they improvise every time.

paths.title: Thoughtful gift pairs
paths.description: Gift pairs in which one item opens the door and the other creates a moment—without padding the present with filler.
paths.lead: A pair works when the two gifts make one experience easier, richer, or more memorable. One great item can still be enough.
paths.shopperCue: Picture the first ten minutes: read and play, notice and look closer, remember and record, pause and return without losing the thread.
